name: AWS
subtitle: Hyperscale public cloud
creator: Amazon
description: On-demand compute (EC2, Lambda, ECS, EKS), storage (S3), databases (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB), networking, identity and AI services across global regions. It is the most used cloud platform among developers.

languages.youWrite: SDKs for every major language, the AWS CLI, CloudFormation, CDK or Terraform

concepts.explanation: Users, roles and policies control access.
AWS secures the cloud; you secure what you put in it.

codeSamples.label: Shell · AWS CLI
codeSamples.code:
# Create a bucket, upload a built site, then call a Lambda function
aws s3 mb s3://my-app-assets-2026
aws s3 sync ./dist s3://my-app-assets-2026 --delete
aws lambda invoke --function-name my-api out.json && cat out.json

cons: Complex; IAM alone is a learning curve

pricing.summary: Pay as you go. New accounts: $100 credit plus up to $100 more; the Free plan lasts up to 6 months. Always free: 1M Lambda requests/mo and 25 GB of DynamoDB.

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
